title: Subtracting Decimals to Hundredths Worksheets
intro: Teach decimal subtraction by modeling each regrouping step.
html:
Teaching notes for parents and teachers

How to teach it

Line up decimal points and show how one tenth can be renamed as ten hundredths. Use addition to check the difference.

Example to work through together

Use the model below as you explain the example. Have your student point to the quantities as you discuss them.

Rename 10.03 without changing its value

Each row represents the same starting value
ValueWholes0.10.01
10.031003
10.039103
10.039913

The 0.1 column counts tenths; the 0.01 column counts hundredths. Exchanging one whole gives ten tenths. Exchanging one of those tenths gives ten more hundredths.

10.03 − 4.78 = 5.25

  1. Remove 8 hundredths from 13 hundredths: 5 hundredths remain.
  2. Remove 7 tenths from the 9 tenths still available: 2 tenths remain.
  3. Remove 4 wholes from 9 wholes: 5 wholes remain.

Ask your student

What changed in our notation, and what stayed the same in the amount?

If your student needs help

If the student changes a zero without reducing another place, record the full exchange on a place-value chart.
